caption: The button on an electric kettle is pressed, and a small light on the kettle comes on and the switch stays down.

sa.check: An electric kettle with a button or switch.
A small light on the kettle comes on.
The switch stays down after the press.
The light is dark before the press.
The order is dark, press, lit with the switch down.

pc.expect: The light comes on at the moment the switch goes down, and only then; while the switch is down the light stays on.
pc.fail: The switch is down and the light stays dark; or the light is lit before the switch is touched; or the light comes on with the switch still up; or the switch goes down and springs back up at once with the light staying on.

pc.expect: The switch stays down and the light stays lit for the rest of the clip; if the switch pops up, the light goes out with it.
pc.fail: The light goes out with the switch still down; or the switch pops up and the light stays lit; or the light flickers on and off; or the switch goes up and down by itself.

pc.expect: Any steam from the spout appears only after the switch is down and grows from there.
pc.fail: Steam pours from the spout before the button is pressed; or steam appears and shrinks back into the spout; or steam rises from the base rather than the spout.

pc.expect: The kettle stays on its base as the button is pressed; the base and counter stay still.
pc.fail: The kettle slides or lifts off its base at the press; or the base moves by itself; or items on the counter jump.

pc.expect: One kettle on one base; the kettle keeps its shape with the lid on; the finger passes through nothing.
pc.fail: A second kettle appears; or the kettle vanishes; or the finger passes into the kettle; or the kettle's spout or handle moves or vanishes.

pc.expect: The kettle's colour, the base and the counter stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The kettle changes colour; or the switch moves to a different place on the kettle; or items on the counter change.
